# Meta Developers

> Meta's developer documentation platform providing resources for building VR/XR applications across Oculus, Unreal Engine, and OpenXR platforms.

Meta Developers hosts comprehensive technical documentation and tools for developers creating virtual reality and extended reality experiences. The platform covers development frameworks, SDKs, and best practices for building immersive applications.

## Key Topics

- Oculus Audio Loudness Meter
- Unreal Engine
- VR Development
- Meta XR Plugin
- OpenXR
- Audio Tools
- Android Studio
- Developer Documentation
- XR Development
- Audio Engineering

## Audio Development Tools

- [Oculus Audio Loudness Meter Overview](https://developers.meta.com/horizon/documentation/unreal/audio-loudness-meter-overview/?locale=ru_RU): Guide to Oculus Audio Loudness Meter tool for Unreal Engine VR development
